steps.why: The whole point is that the flower is above ground and only the fruit is below, so the sequence must be stated.
common_mistakes: Saying the flower itself opens under the soil. It does not.
Confusing it with a root. The pod is a fruit, not a root.
steps.memory_tip: geo = earth, carpy = fruit. Fruit in the earth.
steps.margin_note: Two lines: the definition, then how the fruit gets under the soil.

steps.label: The plant
lines: It belongs to the family Fabaceae. The species
name hypogaea itself means "below the earth".
steps.why: One correct named example with its family is all the second mark asks for.
common_mistakes: Spelling it hypogea. The correct spelling is hypogaea.
Giving only the common name when the question expects the botanical name.
steps.memory_tip: hypogaea = hypo (below) + gaea (earth), the same idea as geocarpy in the plant’s own name.
steps.margin_note: Write the botanical name in italics or underline it.
